2438-5170-6132-8292.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

1981-2415-7272-7452.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-7272-7452.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

822-5261-7170.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
822-5261-7170.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-5261-7170.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Living Brain.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

512-4644-7308.easyPrerequisites:
Mona Lisa and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
Mona Lisa has power 2 or greater.
512-4644-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Mona Lisa, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4644-7308.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Mona Lisa's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

3490-4871-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-6351-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-6351-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-6794.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1086-1981-2415-2511.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1086-1981-2415-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1874-1981-2415-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1874-1981-2415-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

824-2728-5231-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-5231-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-5231-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

225-4094-4365-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-4094-4365-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

4067-7203-7890.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other creatures
4067-7203-7890.description:
Activate Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind.
Repeat.

1912-7426-7628-7811.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1912-7426-7628-7811.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1409-3099-4289-7730.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3532-5060-5078-5957.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
3532-5060-5078-5957.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-2933-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Drowner of Hope, adding {C}{C}.
When Drowner of Hope dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Drowner of Hope from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Drowner of Hope enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3605-4812-5147-6553.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

703-4890-7149.description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Dack's Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Dack's Duplicate dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Dack's Duplicate enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Dack's Duplicates into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Dack's Duplicate tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-4890-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-3259-7295.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-7295.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

116-283-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
116-283-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting that ability.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers. Holding priority, activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Illusionist's Bracers' trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Illusionist Bracers' trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Illusionist's Bracers' trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Illusionist's bracers' trigger twice.
Repeat from step 5.

232-1235-1309-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

562-3497-7070.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
562-3497-7070.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Warrior en-Kor.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Warrior en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat.

339-677-4927-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1020-1796-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

654-1445-2366-4365-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
654-1445-2366-4365-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2558-4779-5687-5692.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Weapons Trainer, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1909-4486-4667.notablePrerequisites: Elvish Aberration does not have summoning sickness.
1909-4486-4667.description:
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Repeat.
1909-4486-4667.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

997-4881-5011.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cavalier of Night.
When Cavalier of Night dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

790-1368-3883.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
A player has at least three cards in hand.
790-1368-3883.description:
Cast Windfall from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand, then causing you to draw at least three cards, then create that many Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.

1385-1745-3054-4871-5111.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Lord of the Forsaken ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast a spell from your graveyard.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1124-1543-2311.notablePrerequisites: The number of creatures you control plus two times the number of other planeswalkers you control is at least eleven.
1124-1543-2311.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Huatli's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting an additional loyalty counter on it for each creature you control.
If necessary, activate any other planeswalker you control by putting zero loyalty counters on it, causing you to put a loyalty counter on Huatli.
Repeat step 3 until Huatli has at least thirteen loyalty.
Activate Huatli by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

643-1606-3510.notablePrerequisites: Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
643-1606-3510.description:
Activate any land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it and the land.
Repeat.

1911-3955.description:
Activate Wandering Fumarole's ability so that it becomes a creature.
Activate it to switch its power and toughness infinite times to get infinite Ceaseless Searblades triggers.
Repeat.

813-1987-2427-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
